recurrence: F_n = F_(n-2) + F_(n-1), for every integer n >= 2
endpoint_reason: F_40 is the first Fibonacci term strictly greater than 100,000,000; F_39=63,245,986
character_selection_reason: user_override_after_random_draw; parent records the selection history
character_pose_status: four episode-specific generated key poses added: watch_left, present_half, present_full, delighted; not a production animation acceptance
boundary_definition: Normal generated-term boundary is result-count speech end to the next formula-prefix speech start, not result-count to result-count. At six pedagogical checkpoints this boundary includes explanation audio, deliberate sentence gaps, and a final 2-second settling interval.
checkpoint_editing_status: speech-driven provisional; no fixed silent hold to force runtime
timing_method: Every planned speech window is word_count * 60 / 150 at the baseline. All start/end seconds are estimates, not PCM-derived timings. Slower end uses 130 wpm with the same fixed transitions. Contractions count as one word; hyphenated cardinal components count individually.
duration_formula_seconds: S_all_adopted_utterances + 107.040; replace provisional speech windows using measured PCM, then revise editorial fit
runtime_contingency: If adopted natural speech plus these meaningful cues is shorter than 480 seconds, extend the range to a documented endpoint or add a specific, useful place-value lesson and new narration; do not slow the established voice or repeat empty waits. Confirm before production, not after rendering.

math_source.retrieval: Official OEIS search result exposed terms F_0 through F_40; direct page and b-file access returned HTTP403. Values cross-checked by recurrence and an independent binomial-sum identity.
math_source.source_scope: initial terms and recurrence; storyboard, pacing, wording and visual concepts are original planning decisions
